promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... play a card (A>10>K>Q>J>9>8>7; must follow suit, then must trump if void)
promptMarriageHelp: Marriage: leading the K or Q from a same-suit K+Q in hand scores +20 (+40 in the trump suit)
promptTrickEndHelp: n / next ... go to the next trick
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... go to the next round
hintReasonLeadLow: Lead a low card to conserve points
hintReasonFollowWin: Points on the table — win the trick
hintReasonDiscardLow: Cannot follow suit — discard a low card
helpExampleNext: n                        read the trick result, then start the next trick
